task: ORCHESTRATION-RELEASE-001 native tool contracts and restricted-mode compatibility
scope: Bounded compatibility test and evidence receipt; no product feature changes.

method.current_runtime_inventory: The exact release contract test fixture constructs through ToolManager, AgentInitializer._load_tools with explicitly attached MemorySearchTool and MemoryGetTool, then AgentStreamExecutor._select_tools_for_injection/build_tools_schema. Private HOME/COW_DATA_DIR; synthetic profile/workspace; self_evolution_enabled=false, subagent.enabled=false, no teammates, synthetic tools.web_search.anysearch_anonymous=true with strategy=fixed; network connect is patched to fail; no provider request is made.
method.limits: Historical release-verification receipt records 16 names and canonical schema hashes but does not preserve the exact provider/subagent config values. Current test pins the documented historical names under an explicit synthetic fixture; it does not claim production config parity.

current_raw_tool_manager.note: Raw ToolManager includes gated options; memory_search/get are intentionally skipped and attached separately by AgentInitializer.

tools.name: bash

bash_id.description: Read whatever a background command has printed since you last looked. Pass this instead of command.

command.description: Bash command to execute. Omit when reading from or killing a background command.

kill.description: With bash_id, stop that background command.

run_in_background.description: Start the command and return immediately with a bash_id instead of waiting. Use this ONLY for a long-lived process that is meant to keep running, such as a server or a watcher. A command that is only slow should use a larger timeout rather than set this parameter, so its output comes back in the same call. No need to add '&' yourself. Background jobs keep running after the task ends unless you kill them.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait, default 120, max 600. The call returns as soon as the command finishes, so a high value never costs waiting time - set it generously for installs and builds instead of risking a timeout.

action.description: 操作类型: create(创建), list(列表), get(查询), delete(删除), enable(启用), disable(禁用)

ai_task.description: 任务描述 (与message二选一)，描述到点时需要 Agent 执行的任务，例如执行什么操作、交付什么内容，无需重复声明调度时间（由 schedule 决定）。

compatibility.restricted_worker_blocked: Bash, browser, web_search, web_fetch, vision, send, env_config, scheduler, memory tools, evolution_undo, subagent, agent_delegate, MCP, and unknown tools. Restricted child construction uses a fresh allowlist of the six exact native classes; unknown or same-name wrong-class tools fail closed.
compatibility.full_access: Known registered native implementations retain privileged host behavior; unknown classes and dynamic MCP tools do not inherit host privilege by name.
limits: Filesystem scope checks are an argument-level native broker, not an OS sandbox.
Restricted workers cannot launch processes, use browser/MCP/remote peers or access memory tools.
Web search availability depends on configured provider/anonymous opt-in.
The native browser proof used installed system Chrome with headless mode, a fresh tmp_path profile per case, and file:// fixtures; no install, network or user profile.

gaps.finding: Production tool availability depends on provider configuration, self-evolution and shared-conversation roster. The test pins the 16-tool contract with synthetic AnySearch opt-in, disabled subagent/self-evolution and no teammates; it does not read production config.

decision: The 16-tool active request inventory and full current parameter schemas pass the new deterministic fixture. Active parameter source modules match origin/master. All 17 ToolManager classes/descriptors, two attached memory descriptors, the restricted worker class allowlist, and authorized optional root/verification schemas are checked. Production-dependent availability is not certified.

assertions: 16 injected names equal the historical baseline names under the explicit synthetic availability fixture
All 16 complete input schemas equal this receipt manifest; this covers property names, types, required fields, enums, defaults and descriptions
All 17 ToolManager native registry entries map to their exact expected class and descriptor
Both dynamically attached memory tools map to their exact expected class and descriptor
Restricted worker construction contains exactly six approved native classes
Subagent and AgentDelegate full parameter schemas are checked separately; authorized root/verification additions remain optional

authorized_schema_additions.provenance: Compared with original master c2c39a2e source, the additive task root and verification fields are confined to these two schema contracts.

goal.description: What the sub agent should accomplish. Write it as a complete instruction to someone who has never seen this conversation.

context.description: Everything the sub agent needs and cannot look up: file paths, error text, decisions already made, what to leave alone. It cannot see your conversation, so anything you omit is lost.

read_roots.description: Explicit absolute paths to share for reading, within your authority.

write_roots.description: Explicit absolute paths to share for writing, within your authority.

verification.description: Frozen independent checks. Relative paths use the worker task directory. Acceptance checks validate output; external_state checks independently read filesystem state. Missing or unsupported checks remain unverified; remote services are unsupported.

subagent_type.description: Which kind of sub agent to use. See the list in this tool's description.

tasks.description: Run several tasks at once instead of one. Each entry takes the same goal / context / subagent_type fields, and every entry runs in parallel.

verification.description: Frozen independent checks. Relative paths use the worker task directory. Acceptance checks validate output; external_state checks independently read filesystem state. Missing or unsupported checks remain unverified; remote services are unsupported.

agent_id.description: The teammate's Agent ID (the @id shown for them in the team conversation section).

task.description: A self-contained task for the teammate, with everything it needs to act without seeing this conversation.

verification.description: Frozen independent checks. Relative paths use the worker task directory. Acceptance checks validate output; external_state checks independently read filesystem state. Missing or unsupported checks remain unverified; remote services are unsupported.

authorized_schema_additions.assertions: Both are exact-schema tested separately. New root and verification fields are optional and do not enter the required list.
